subject: Request: Art 28/30 pack + DPIA evidence for EU transfer assurance
messages:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@greenbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oconnor@greenbank.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:11:00Z
Subject: Request: evidence for DPA (Art.28/30) + DPIA support for EU transfers

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier. GreenBank is progressing on our procurement checklist for Redwood and the security/compliance team have asked for a consolidated pack we can share with our Data Protection Officer. Specifically they need:  
- A statement of processing (Art.30) that lists categories of processing and retention for the hosted inference API;
- The Art.28 processor subprocessor list and contract extracts showing flow-down obligations (encryption, audit rights, subprocessors);
- Any DPIA artifacts or summary reports demonstrating controls for cross-border transfers (we're focusing on transfers from EU to US cloud regions and to any third-country subprocessors);
- Evidence of SOC2-type controls and KMS/HSM usage for customer keys where applicable.

Can Redwood provide a single ZIP (or Drive folder) with a short cover note and the artifacts above? Also please flag any residual gaps so we can scope confidentiality requirements. We need this by EOD Friday (2026-08-14) to keep our internal review timeline.

Thanks,
Emma Sullivan
Legal Ops | GreenBank

[Attachment: GreenBank_RequestChecklist_20260805.pdf (pdf, 45 KB)]

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T10:02:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: evidence for DPA (Art.28/30) + DPIA support for EU transfers

Team — forwarding GreenBank's ask. Key deliverables and deadlines below. I can own the DPA/Art.28 excerpts + cover note; Karthik can you pull the subprocessor CSV and contract snippets (we should include the last signed addenda for each subprocessor where we flow down Art.28 obligations)? Kimberly please surface the DPIA summary and any exports from our DPIA tracker that speak to EU->US processing, key management, and risk mitigations. Markus, can you confirm where to pull the SOC2 evidence bundle (we'll include SOC2 Type II summary and the list of attestations)?

Deadline: Friday EOD (2026-08-14) to meet GreenBank timeline.

Notes for artifacts:  
- For Art.30: we should produce a concise table (purpose, categories of data, retention, legal basis).
- For Art.28: redacted contract excerpts that show processor obligations and audit clauses (we shouldn't send full customer contracts).
- DPIA: a short executive summary + supporting screenshots/exports from the DPIA tool.

I'll start drafting the cover note and will assemble into a Drive folder and DocuSign packet if required.

Thanks — Priya N.
Priya Natarajan
Senior Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: GreenBank_RequestChecklist_20260805.pdf referenced above]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T14:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: evidence for DPA (Art.28/30) + DPIA support for EU transfers

Priya — attaching the subprocessor inventory and the contract snippets we can share. I've included a CSV with current active subprocessors and the last negotiated flow-down clause we use (column called "standard_flowdown_clause_id"). Where we rely on cloud provider controls for key management I've annotated the row. I'm also flagging two subprocessors (thirdrow.ai and edge-cache-pro) that are undergoing a security review and have pending attestations; I marked them in the CSV with "pending_evidence".

I'll redact any line items where vendor NDAs prevent sharing. If GreenBank needs full contact information for a subprocessor we'll route requests through vendor management.

Attachments (stubs):  
- Subprocessor_Mapping_Q3_2026.csv (csv, 27 KB)
- DPA_Art28_Annex_v3.pdf (pdf, 340 KB) -- this includes the contract excerpt template and clause references we propose to share.

Karthik Iyer
Vendor Risk & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@greenbank.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T15:07:00Z
Subject: Redwood: Art.28/30 pack + DPIA evidence (GreenBank request)

Hi Emma / Liam,

Attached is the folder we prepared for GreenBank to support your internal DPO review. Summary below and a short cover note attached in the Drive link.

What we've included:  
- Art.30 statement (processing_activities_art30.pdf) — high-level table of processing categories, legal bases, retention windows.
- Art.28 excerpts (DPA_Art28_Annex_v3.pdf) — redacted contract clause package showing flow-down obligations and audit rights.
- Subprocessor mapping (Subprocessor_Mapping_Q3_2026.csv) — active subprocessors, locations, and evidence status; rows flagged "pending_evidence" indicate items we are actively closing.
- DPIA summary (DPIA_Exported_Evidence.xlsx) — executive summary + control mapping for cross-border transfers, including mitigations (prefix/KV caching policy, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, KMS usage) and residual risk ratings.
- SOC2 summary + attestations link (SOC2-summary.txt and link in cover note).

Quick callouts:  
- Two subprocessors currently have pending attestations; we've noted compensating controls in the DPIA summary.
- For encryption with customer-managed keys (Private deployment option), we included a short section describing HSM/KMS architecture.
- If you require formal audit access beyond the contractual audit clause, let me know and we can discuss scope and timing (we do limited on-site and virtual audit sessions under NDA).

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/GreenBank-DPA-Pack-2026
DocuSign (DPA signature packet) if you want to execute: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/XYZ-12345

Attachments (sent as redacted stubs):  
- DPA_Art28_Annex_v3.pdf (pdf, 340 KB)
- Subprocessor_Mapping_Q3_2026.csv (csv, 27 KB)
- DPIA_Exported_Evidence.xlsx (xlsx, 98 KB)

If you'd like a 30-minute walkthrough of the pack with our privacy and infra engineers, happy to schedule early next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@greenbank.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.oconnor@greenbank.com
Date: 2026-08-14T16:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood: Art.28/30 pack + DPIA evidence (GreenBank request)

Priya — thank you, this is exactly what we needed and on time. I've shared the Drive folder with our DPO and InfoSec team. A couple quick items:  
- We might follow up on the two pending subprocessors for evidence; would you be able to provide an ETA on those attestations?
- Our DPO asked if Redwood can confirm whether any subprocessor data transfers occur outside the EU without SCCs in place — your Art.28 pack looked comprehensive but the DPO wants explicit confirmation or an exception list.

Can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough on Monday 2026-08-17 at 09:00 CET? If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — Emma
Emma Sullivan
Legal Ops | GreenBank

[Signed: Emma Sullivan]
